title: Configuration constants
description: Declare constants to configure an application: app name, version, creation year, maximum number of users and price per subscription. Then show all the constants formatted.
hints: All constants must be public static final
Names go in UPPERCASE with underscores
Use System.out.printf for formatting with decimals if you wish
solutionExplanation: We declare class constants with public static final following the UPPERCASE naming convention. The constants are used as fixed values throughout the application.
expectedOutput:
App: Gestor de Tareas v1.2.0
Creation year: 2026
Maximum users: 1000
Subscription price: $9.99

--- Configuration summary ---
Gestor de Tareas v1.2.0 (2026)
Users: up to 1000
Subscription: $9.99/month

title: Ticket system with Enum
description: Create a TicketPrioridad enum with levels BAJA, MEDIA, ALTA, CRITICA. Each level has a response time in hours and a color. Create a method that receives a priority and shows its configuration.
hints: The enum needs private final fields
The constructor is private (public is not added)
Use switch or if for esUrgente(), or better: return prioridad.ordinal() >= 2
solutionExplanation: We create an enum with properties (tiempoRespuesta, emoji) and methods (getTiempoRespuesta, esUrgente). We iterate all values with values() and show the formatted information with printf.
expectedOutput:
Priority BAJA: ⏱ 48h 🟢 - Urgent? false
Priority MEDIA: ⏱ 24h 🟡 - Urgent? false
Priority ALTA: ⏱ 8h 🟠 - Urgent? true
Priority CRITICA: ⏱ 2h 🔴 - Urgent? true

title: Subscription plan calculator with Enum
description: Create a PlanSuscripcion enum (GRATIS, BASICO, PREMIUM, EMPRESARIAL). Each plan has a monthly price, storage in GB and number of allowed users. Implement methods to calculate the annual price with discount and check whether a plan supports certain features.
hints: Each enum constant is defined with parameters: BASICO(9.99, 10, 5)
The constructor runs for each enum constant
To recommend a plan, iterate the values and check that maxUsuarios >= 20
solutionExplanation: We define an enum with 3 properties and business methods (precioAnual, soportaAlmacenamiento, esGratuito). The constructor assigns values to each constant. We iterate the plans to show recommendations based on needs.
expectedOutput:

GRATIS: $0.00/month → $0.00/year | 1GB | 1 user (GRATIS)
